text:
arne: quick ideaor autofallback UX: when a fallback triggers, enter a short "sample-and-hold" mode that captures a forensic snapshot of the request + signals for audit and evals.
lina: love that. snapshot = request input, model variant, kv/cache state, sidecar signals, small trace window. keep it tiny (<=1KB) and anonymize PII.
chuck: ops concern: storage and perf. we should sample only the first N fallbacks per minute and rate-limit per-customer. also a metrics-only mode for piloting.
mei: UX: console inbox card shows "Auto-fallback (sample)" badge. click -> preview snapshot + option: mark for eval set / export. also show why (trigger: p99 latency, confidence:0.84).
arne: policy: rollout config adds section: sample_and_hold {enabled, sample_rate, max_per_minute, hold_ttl}. defaults: disabled.
lina: security: require opt-in for customer data retention; anonymize and store decision_id, not raw user_id. log cert thumbprint for signer.
chuck: implementation: sidecar + arbiter attach decision_id; when accepted, snapshot written to a tsv topic `fallback.snapshots`. retention 90d, exportable.
mei: playback: button to replay request in sandbox; disabled by default for prod. must require operator annotation to pull into eval corpora.
arne: edgecase: repeated noisy triggers for synthetic traffic. add noise filter: ignore requests with UA:synthetic or x-internal.
ops-bot: NOTE: created ticket INFRA-1422 for sample-and-hold pilot.
chuck: action items: runtime: decision_id + snapshot emitter (owner: chuck, EOW). platform: snapshot schema + timeline UI (owner: mei, next Tue). security: anonymization checklist (owner: lina).
lina: pilot in metrics-only mode behind feature flag. will draft RFC.
arne: thanks all. this gives SREs forensic context without spilling the logs. :raised_hands:
